description: This is a web interface for visualizing database contents. It includes HTML structure, embedded CSS styles, and JavaScript code for fetching and displaying database and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
